title: Package Android TWA build with custom app icon

requirements.text: Generate and add the required Android app icon PNG assets as static files under `frontend/public/assets/generated/` using the exact filenames referenced by the PWA manifest: `android-app-icon.dim_192x192.png` and `android-app-icon.dim_512x512.png`.
acceptanceCriteria: The files `frontend/public/assets/generated/android-app-icon.dim_192x192.png` and `frontend/public/assets/generated/android-app-icon.dim_512x512.png` exist in the repo.
Loading `/assets/generated/android-app-icon.dim_192x192.png` and `/assets/generated/android-app-icon.dim_512x512.png` in the browser returns HTTP 200 and displays valid PNG images.

requirements.text: Ensure the PWA manifest continues to reference the custom Android icons at `/assets/generated/android-app-icon.dim_192x192.png` and `/assets/generated/android-app-icon.dim_512x512.png`, so the Android TWA wrapper (Bubblewrap/Android Studio flow) uses the custom icon from the manifest.
acceptanceCriteria: `frontend/public/manifest.webmanifest` contains icon entries for sizes 192x192 and 512x512 pointing to `/assets/generated/android-app-icon.dim_192x192.png` and `/assets/generated/android-app-icon.dim_512x512.png`.
The manifest remains valid JSON and is served at `/manifest.webmanifest`.

requirements.text: Update `frontend/ANDROID_TWA_BUILD.md` to explicitly instruct how to package the Android app using the custom icon (Bubblewrap prompt values and the exact icon URLs), and include a short verification checklist confirming the manifest and icon URLs return HTTP 200 before building the APK/AAB.
acceptanceCriteria: `frontend/ANDROID_TWA_BUILD.md` includes the exact icon URL paths `/assets/generated/android-app-icon.dim_192x192.png` and `/assets/generated/android-app-icon.dim_512x512.png` in the steps/checklist.
The guide clearly states to use the 512x512 icon URL when Bubblewrap requests the icon, and to ensure the manifest icon URLs are accessible before building.

nonGoals: Implementing native Android features beyond packaging the existing PWA via TWA.
Setting up automated CI signing/release pipelines for APK/AAB generation.

required: Square app icon, Han’s Laser themed, high-contrast, simplified mark on solid background (android-app-icon.dim_192x192.png, 192x192)
Square app icon, Han’s Laser themed, high-contrast, simplified mark on solid background (android-app-icon.dim_512x512.png, 512x512)
